text:
maya: Customer ticket #4567 — after pinning to a specific model variant post-upgrade they report embeddings length changed from 1024 -> 1536 and downstream similarity scores broke. They attached a small repro.

maya: Customer repro curl (redacted):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \\
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-large:quant-v2","input":"hello world"}'
```
Response snippet:
```
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [{"object":"embedding","embedding":[0.001,0.002,...],"index":0}],
  "meta": {"embedding_dim":1536}
}
```

maya: They say the client expects dim=1024 (older model) and the index breaks. They pinned the model a week ago.

josh: Thanks — can you paste the request_id from their failing request? need the server logs to correlate. Also what's the exact pinned identifier? full model name + pin timestamp if available.

maya: Request id: rq_84f2c9d7. Pinned identifier: open-embed-large@20250210-quant-v2 (customer UI shows "pinned:open-embed-large:quant-v2").

lena: Quick hypothesis: quant-v2 introduces a fused projection that changed the raw embedding size (we did a concat for extra features in that variant). Normally we expose a stable shape but the pin logic should have served the backward-compatible variant. possible runtime routing bug where a newer artifact got served for pinned tag.

lena: Can you ask the customer to hit the model-metadata endpoint: `GET /v1/models/open-embed-large@20250210-quant-v2/metadata` — it should list `embedding_dim`. Also `GET /v1/models/open-embed-large/versions` to see what was pushed under that tag.

maya: Customer ran metadata call and returned `{"embedding_dim":1536, "artifact": "open-embed-large-20250210-quant-v2-rc3"}`. They attached logs showing the index ingester failed with shape mismatch error: `ValueError: expected 1024, got 1536` during upsert.

dave: Deploy-bot shows a canary rollout at 2025-02-11 03:12 UTC with commit f2a7c9d that changed projection dimension for quant-v2 artifacts. That was intended (feature flagged) and shouldn't have affected pinned versions, but looks like tag-to-artifact resolution returned the new artifact id for that pin.

josh: Ok, two follow-ups: (1) short-term mitigation: advise customer to switch to the explicit artifact stable name (open-embed-large@20241201) or to our older non-quant variant so their index stays intact; (2) internal: we need to verify pin resolution logic. I'll get a repro by resolving the tag they used and checking the mapping table.

lena: For repro: I can run a local server with the two artifacts and compare metadata. Quick check command: `python -m redwood.tools.resolve_tag --tag open-embed-large@20250210-quant-v2`. Expect it to return the artifact id. If it returns the newer artifact we can trace who updated the tag.

maya: Customer accepted short-term workaround and can switch to `open-embed-large@20241201` — they asked if we can backfill a conversion or if we recommend reindexing.

lena: If they want to preserve vectors we can provide a conversion script that runs an SVD/linear projection to map 1536->1024 but that will have quality loss. Recommend reindexing with the canonical model to be safe. We can provide prioritised support for the reindex job.

josh: I'll open an internal incident to track root cause and rollback/pin-fix. Action items:
- josh: verify tag->artifact resolution logs and patch the resolver (ETA 4h).
- dave: check the deploy canary config and whether feature flag gating failed (ETA 2h).
- lena: prepare conversion script + docs for customers (ETA EOD).
- maya: coordinate with customer on temporary artifact pin and reindex schedule.

deploy-bot: canary rollout f2a7c9d -> 3 nodes (us-west-2) at 2025-02-11T03:12:47Z.

maya: Customer will pin to `open-embed-large@20241201` and start reindexing tomorrow morning PST. They asked for a post-mortem once we fix the resolver. I told them we'll follow up and offer reindex credits if needed.

josh: Noted. I'll post updates here after I confirm resolver logs. If anyone finds immediate hotfix (tag rewrite) please ping me before changing live mappings.

lena: also adding a regression test to ensure embedding_dim reported by metadata matches the artifact actual projection shape (unit test + integration check).

maya: Closing loop with customer in thread and marking ticket as "workaround applied".

josh: Thanks all, will update within the hour.
